title: SIMPLE RANK-AVERAGE ENSEMBLE
hypothesis: The two non-dominated finalists contain sufficiently different ranking information that a simple fixed 50/50 rank-average can improve robustness or predictive consistency without introducing material complexity or cost.
formula: for each signal_date: ensemble_score = 0.5 * percentile_rank(LGBM_REGRESSION_score) + 0.5 * percentile_rank(LAMBDAMART_score); deterministic average ties; no missing imputation

predictive_evaluation.label: existing RAW 60-session forward-return rank used only as a common evaluation yardstick
predictive_evaluation.reason: same economic realized horizon for both parents and ensemble; no ensemble-specific target/horizon optimization

success.predictive_comparable: mean IC, median IC and NDCG each no worse than weaker parent minus 0.01
success.economic_usable: 50bps mean net return >= 90% of weaker parent; turnover <=110% of higher parent; fill >=95%; 100bps and +2 delay mean return positive
success.adds_value: predictive comparable and either mean IC exceeds both by >=0.01 or 50bps mean net exceeds both by >=5%, without worse daily MaxDD
success.adds_robustness_only: predictive comparable and economic usable and ensemble IC std is below both parents or top1/sector concentration is below both parents
success.otherwise: DOES NOT ADD RELIABLE VALUE if comparable/economic conditions fail; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
